scope: Direct dependencies declared by this repository: tracked Git submodules, root service Rust manifest, Web UI npm manifest, pinned compiler/build inputs and host migration/diagnostic helpers. Upstream-owned transitive manifests and the separate ignored garage-app are excluded.
policy: Apply compatible source/package updates and rebase patches; record major migrations, compiler baselines and operational tool pins separately. A newer release recorded here is not claimed to be installed.
system_packages: Host gcc/clang/Java, distribution Python packages, Docker Ubuntu 24.04 packages and apt-managed tools are environment prerequisites, not repository-pinned package versions. Stock gateway libraries are an immutable ABI fixture, not upgrade candidates.
inactive_gitmodules: QuickJS appears in .gitmodules but has no tracked gitlink or active build dependency. Repeated Lua/QuickJS entries are existing metadata.
